reviewed_by: Claude Code, after the 2026-11-21 live promote stopped on a transient HTTP 500 from deployment status
reason: The simulation deployer now rides out transient Core failures during promotion. CoreClient.read (nebula_deploy_gate.py) retries HTTP 500/502/503/504, timeouts and reset or refused connections with bounded backoff (about 150 s), logs each retry, raises CoreUnavailable with the re-run-promote hint past the bound, and fails at once on 4xx; StagedDeployer and reconcile_operation's readback use it. deployment_post re-sends a new operation under its saved operation_id after a lost reply (Core returns the saved receipt and never dispatches an ID twice) and reads a still-running receipt until it settles; reconciliation POSTs are not re-sent. Selected: test_simulation_deploy_gate_reads.py (read retry, bound, 4xx, plain get unchanged), test_staged_deployer.py (a status read failing twice with 500 lets promotion continue; persistent 500 stops with the resume message and the rerun resumes the same journal without double-applying; 4xx fails at once), test_deployer_protocol.py (lost POST reply read back, not re-applied; bound; 4xx; reconcile not re-sent; running receipt settles), test_simulation_deploy_resume.py and test_simulation_dead_owner_activation.py (promote and resume paths through staged_deployer), tests/v3/test_deployment_inventory_reads.py (deploy gate reads).
exclusions: test_simulation_host_activation.py, test_simulation_host_restart.py and test_simulation_postgres_backup.py do not reach the changed reads (they pass unchanged) and each has a test that also fails on pristine origin/main on this host (pidfd stop and PostgreSQL rollback environment). The other test_simulation_deployer_* files cover CI evidence, prebuild and retention, not Core reads. No API, UI, setting or operator workflow changed, so no frontend, Playwright or LAN-instance journey applies.
